comment.text: Placeholder for a text input field in the Javascript SDK configuration, used when defining the button text for a main element.

usage.context:
<Label className="label" text={t("ButtonText")} />
 <TextInput
 scale
 name="button_text"
 onChange={setButtonText}
 placeholder={t("SelectToPortal", {
 productName: getBrandName("ProductName"),
 })}
 value={buttonValue}
 tabIndex={3}
 testId="button_mode_text_input"
